anchor.semantic_hook: Making news is staged as feeding concrete event objects into a newsroom press that physically produces picture-only newspapers and television footage.
anchor.setting: An empty newsroom workshop contains a broad printing press, a television camera, a blank monitor, and sorting tables for interchangeable event props. The press impossibly accepts whole objects through its rollers and releases neat stacks of picture-only newspapers showing those objects.
anchor.absurd_element: a newsroom press that swallows whole event objects and turns them into pictured newspapers

inserts.action: stands tense and protective beside the press, pulling a home key, a heart-shaped locket, and a closed personal album back from rollers that are drawing them in again

variations.scene_adjust: a home key, a heart-shaped locket, a closed personal album, a microphone, and a fresh stack of picture-only newspapers

inserts.action: stares in disbelief at one tiny toppled ink bottle entering the press while he braces a towering stack of picture-only newspapers emerging from the other side

variations.scene_adjust: one tiny toppled ink bottle and many stacks of picture-only newspapers spread across every sorting table

inserts.action: leans forward with youthful determination and pushes a sapling, a miniature wind turbine, and a reusable bottle toward the press

variations.scene_adjust: a sapling, a miniature wind turbine, a reusable bottle, a plain megaphone, and a small globe

inserts.action: holds up a phone displaying one plain photograph and watches in surprise as the press sends that same image toward the television camera and monitor

variations.scene_adjust: a phone with an icon-free photo display, a television camera, and a monitor showing only the matching photograph

variations.scene_adjust: a grocery bag, a first-aid box, a repaired toy, motionless press rollers, and an empty output table

variations.scene_adjust: spilled coins, a briefcase with a snapped clasp, blank financial sheets, seven unmarked calendar leaves, and continuing newspaper stacks

inserts.action: pauses at the lectern, steps briefly between the open curved gates, and points toward a closed office door, covered desks, and a moon beside the next calendar leaf

variations.scene_adjust: a closed office door, covered desks, a moon model, and two consecutive unmarked calendar leaves

inserts.action: raises one courteous palm from the main aisle, enters the side alcove, and carefully compares coin stacks on a balance before returning toward the lectern

variations.scene_adjust: coin stacks, a balance, a closed cash box, and the next presentation object waiting on the main aisle

inserts.action: stands inside the curved gates during a meeting and demonstrates a laptop by moving simple image tiles between two blank windows on its screen

variations.scene_adjust: a laptop with simple image tiles, a mouse, a projector with a blank display, and a semicircle of empty meeting chairs

variations.scene_adjust: rows of empty chairs, a cluster of completed project tools, and several small unmarked thank-you gifts

variations.scene_adjust: an old coin, a small arch, an antique building model, and several larger city monument models

inserts.action: wears an office badge without markings and irritably moves one folder from a tray to a second tray that feeds it straight back to the first
